mechanism_matrix.scope: production full-grid dxdy norm vs exact control-volume support; the metric measures a different domain than the conserved state
max ZERO_VOLUME energy fraction over the late window = 0.0
partial cells carry a full dx*dy weight in R_prod but only V_i < dx*dy in R_V
sections 13/14 counterfactual operator/one-step evidence on physical cells and faces
angle window spread under the production cadence vs denser available sampling
late-window angle slope and left/right contact-line drift; no gate change

operators.evidence: shared face fluxes are gated by A_f; A_f = 0 on every wall-crossing face
f'(phi) is cell-local; the -eps*fluid_laplacian stencil is aperture-weighted and closed faces contribute zero
K has no row/column at V=0 (A=I there) and every CG inner product is V-weighted, so V=0 contributions vanish exactly
the centred periodic gradient stencil reads neighbour cells regardless of support class
operators.source: phasefield.rhs: cap_x/cap_y = (SIGMA_NORM/We) * mu * (_ddx phi, _ddy phi) / rho_l

operators.evidence: cell-local, but evaluated at every momentum cell including V=0 cells whose predictor enters the global projection
the momentum grid is the full periodic grid; nu(phi) and mu at V=0 cells enter u_rhs/v_rhs there
global divergence/FFT couples every grid cell, including solid rows
the wall measure is assigned to fluid-side control cells (wall_measure_density == 0 wherever V_i == 0)

operator_domain_map.policy: static documentation of the unchanged production operators, anchored to source; stencil visibility of V=0 phase storage is explicit per operator
